description: Liljan wears a navy-blue textured knee-length tunic with tan geometric woven borders around the neckline, sleeve cuffs and hem. A cream underlayer shows at the collar and wrists. Two round gold-toned chest brooches are linked by fine chains. A broad brown leather-like belt with round buckle and metal fittings has a decorated hanging strap. Brown trousers lead into brown wrapped lower-leg coverings with narrow geometric bands and crossing straps above closed brown boots. Fabrics appear wool-like over linen-like cloth, with exact fibers uncertain. Clothing is substantial and opaque; no headgear, armor, weapon or oversized fur appears.
